points.statement: Restoration parameters should be assembled dynamically from the input image and applied at the token level.
points.quote: the model should dynamically assemble restoration parameters conditioned on the input image and apply them at the token level

points.statement: It synthesizes input-conditioned low-rank routing bases and residual directions.
points.quote: synthesize instance-conditioned low-rank routing bases and residual directions

points.statement: Every spatial token builds its own residual update from dense signed dot-product affinities over generated rank-wise components.
points.quote: Each spatial token then assembles its own residual update via dense signed dot-product affinities over the generated rank-wise components

points.statement: Instead of pooling features into a global descriptor, learnable queries probe spatial contexts and decode routing bases and residual directions.
points.quote: Rather than pooling intermediate features into a single global descriptor, the adapter uses learnable queries to probe condensed spatial contexts and decode them into routing bases and residual directions.

points.statement: Assembled residual updates are injected into the restoration backbone's attention projections.
points.quote: The assembled residual updates are injected into the attention projections of the restoration backbone

points.statement: Spatial tokens act as queries, while generated routing bases and residual directions act like keys and values.
points.quote: spatial tokens serve as queries, while the generated routing bases and residual directions play roles analogous to keys and values
